hook:
I built the whole thing around
one question I got sick of dodging

beats.reason: Everything else was cut until the journal screen asked that and offered three ways to answer it.
Each one takes a description of a meal — the thing you already have in your head — and nothing else.

beats.aside: (this is where Day So Far ends)
beats.claim: Then look at Today, or don't
